The expectation was corrected from listener to the full provided statement Sue is listening and meeting Ben; no content or timeout change was used for that correction.

Later five independent exam prompts removed answer-form hints and used already taught meaning contrasts. Each browser reran full question materials and four widths. Chromium reran one real full-account flow per mount; the other seven account paths were unchanged. All WebKit account tests use the final question version.

Unit/workflow checks and both builds overlapped with account validation; no other browser test runner was active during the sequential WebKit account matrix. Catalog and deployment checks ran after the account matrix.

The first font-diagnostics command missed PYTHONPATH; the bundled Python3.12 could not load the existing Brotli cp314 extension. Python3.14 with the existing tmp/font-tools completed the check. These tool-import failures are not product tests.
Final runtime file hashes match independent-test-version.json. Later changes are documentation, evidence and local preview course access.

Normal in-app preview navigation and four cover viewport checks overlapped with the first WebKit account run. No assessment answers were submitted in that preview; its zero stars and first word page remained unchanged. The viewport override was reset.
